verdict.rationale: The docs say agents can be managed through the dashboard, the ElevenLabs API, the Agents CLI, or the hosted MCP server. Agent creation is shown via either the API or the web dashboard, and the hosted MCP lets an assistant create, configure, and manage agents. Nothing claims or shows that every UI capability (such as the visual workflow builder, testing, or analysis settings) is exposed through the API. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API reference coverage of each dashboard feature (workflow builder, testing, analysis, retention), independent or hands-on corroboration of parity

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: ElevenLabs Agents are managed either through the ElevenAgents dashboard, the ElevenLabs API, the Agents CLI or the hosted MCP server.
we'll start by creating an agent via the API or the web dashboard
an assistant such as Claude can create, configure, and manage the agents in your workspace through natural language, with nothing to install or run locally
